details:
Somotimes remote player's voice is muted, and avatar's lipsync is not worked.

It was not recovered re-join or reboot VRChat, but it was recovered the following process.

1. Select muted remote player.

2. Activate user mute.

3. Deactivate user mute.

After this process, voice and lipsync ware recovered. (In my case, three players cannnot hear the latest player's voice, after this process all players recovered)

日本語での説明

たまに他プレイヤーの声が聞こえなくなり、その時リップシンクも動きません。

リジョインや再起動でも治りませんが、以下手順で直りました。

1.  声が出ていないユーザーを選択

2. ユーザーをミュートにする

3. ユーザーのミュートを解除する
title: Remote player's voice is muted
